lines.text: The priest goes to the city gate to examine the healed person and orders two live clean birds.
The person washes, shaves, and bathes, then stays outside his tent seven days and shaves again on the seventh day.
On the eighth day he is presented at the Tent of Meeting entrance, and blood goes on his right earlobe.
A poor person brings one male goat as a guilt offering and two turtledoves or pigeons.
If the mildew reappears and spreads after the house is replastered, the house is unclean and torn down.
